hostages-first.title: Bringing the hostages home was the more important war goal
hostages-first.question: Which of Israel's two declared war goals is more important today: toppling Hamas, or bringing home all the hostages? (share answering the hostages)
hostages-first.source: Israel Democracy Institute, Israeli Voice Index
hostages-first.sample: 598 interviews in Hebrew and 150 in Arabic
hostages-first.note: Toppling Hamas was put first by 25% of all respondents and 38.5% of Jews on the right. IDI gives the January 2024 share for the hostages as about half of the public.

trust.title: Trust in the army, the prime minister and the government
trust.question: Trust to a large or fairly large extent
trust.source: Institute for National Security Studies, National Security Survey
trust.sample: 803 interviews in Hebrew and 133 in Arabic
trust.note: Among Jewish respondents: IDF 83%, Netanyahu 37%, the government 31%. Among Arab respondents: IDF 34%, Netanyahu 6%, the government 5%.
